cohort: 827 pregnant individuals from a randomized clinical trial comparing IADPSG and Carpenter Coustan Criteria, grouped into normal glucose tolerance, mild glucose intolerance, and treated GDM.
finding: Mild glucose intolerance exhibited a metabolic profile similar to treated GDM, and was associated with lower SGA and neonatal composite morbidity but higher maternal composite morbidity compared to normal glucose tolerance, as well as higher LGA but lower SGA and neonatal composite morbidity compared to treated GDM.
